description.en: Read-only MCP server that exposes the dsh-plugin-certification registry: certification grades, snapshot dates, and five-dimension evidence for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Zero runtime dependencies, stdio transport.
description.zh: 只读 MCP 服务器，暴露 dsh-plugin-certification 注册表：DeepSeek Harness 插件的认证等级、快照日期与五维证据；零运行时依赖，stdio 传输。
